Application Data.NAME: Granite & Surface Solutions Inc.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Surface Way, Suite 100, Granite City, IL 12345-6789
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Granite & Surface Solutions Inc. specializes in the professional installation of high-quality countertops and surfaces, including granite, quartz, marble, and engineered stone. Our operations encompass both residential and commercial projects, where we pride ourselves on delivering superior craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. We comply with all applicable fire safety codes and utilize trained employees for the majority of our installations. Our commitment to quality and safety ensures meticulous handling of materials, minimizing risks of installation damage to client property. Additionally, we maintain strong relationships with reputable suppliers to guarantee the integrity of our materials, further enhancing our operational standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, a minor accident occurred during installation at a residential property, resulting in damage to the client's kitchen cabinets. The cause was identified as an unexpected slip while moving a granite slab. The estimated repair cost was $2,500. The claim has been reported to our insurance provider and is currently pending evaluation. No injuries were reported, and all safety protocols were adhered to during the installation process.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: TL-15, UL Listed, Fire Resistant, with a capacity of 1,500 lbs.
